pinyin: lì shǐ zǒng shì jīng rén de xiāng sì

meaning.en: Events of the past tend to repeat themselves in new forms.
meaning.zh: 过去发生的事情常常以新的形式重演。

examples.zh: 股市泡沫破裂，历史总是惊人的相似。
examples.en: The stock bubble burst; history is always strikingly similar.

examples.zh: 读史才知道，历史总是惊人的相似。
examples.en: Only by reading history do you learn how alike it keeps turning out.

usage.en: A modern saying; commonly used in commentary on economics and politics. Not a quotation from a classical text.
usage.zh: 现代常用语，多用于时评、经济与政治评论，并非出自古籍。

natural: it already existed in ancient times

meaning.en: Something that people think is new has in fact existed since long ago.
meaning.zh: 某事物并非新鲜，古代就已经有了。

examples.zh: 所谓网络诈骗，其实古已有之，只是手段不同。
examples.en: So-called online fraud has existed for ages; only the methods differ.

examples.zh: 互相攀比之风，古已有之。
examples.en: The habit of keeping up with the Joneses is nothing new.

usage.en: Often a dry comment deflating claims of novelty.
usage.zh: 常带有“并不新鲜”的淡淡调侃。

natural: a master from beyond the world

meaning.en: A highly gifted person living apart from worldly affairs, as in martial-arts stories.
meaning.zh: 超脱尘世、本领高超的隐居者，常见于武侠小说。

examples.zh: 传说山里住着一位世外高人。
examples.en: Legend says a hermit master lives in the mountains.

examples.zh: 他一副世外高人的模样，不问世事。
examples.en: He looks like a recluse sage, aloof from worldly matters.

usage.en: Also used jokingly of someone surprisingly talented and low-key.
usage.zh: 也可戏称深藏不露、本领出众的人。

natural: entrust one's feelings to mountains and streams

meaning.en: To find comfort and spiritual release in the beauty of nature.
meaning.zh: 把情怀寄托在山水之间，以自然风光抒怀排忧。

examples.zh: 退休后，他寄情山水，游遍名山大川。
examples.en: After retiring he found joy in nature and toured famous mountains and rivers.

examples.zh: 失意的诗人常寄情山水。
examples.en: Disappointed poets often turned to landscape for solace.

usage.en: Literary; fits retirees, poets and travel writing.
usage.zh: 偏书面，多用于退休者、诗人及游记。

meaning.en: To be bedridden for a long time by a lingering illness.
meaning.zh: 长期被疾病缠身，卧床不起。

equivalents: be laid up for a long time

examples.zh: 老人缠绵病榻多年，全靠家人照顾。
examples.en: The old man has been bedridden for years, cared for by his family.

examples.zh: 她晚年缠绵病榻，仍坚持写作。
examples.en: She was ill in bed through her last years yet kept writing.

usage.en: Formal and a little literary; used in news and biographies.
usage.zh: 较正式，略带书面色彩，常见于新闻与传记。

pinyin: yī shí jī qǐ qiān céng làng
literal: one · stone · stir up · thousand · layers · waves
natural: one stone stirs a thousand ripples

meaning.en: A single remark or event sets off wide and strong reactions.
meaning.zh: 一句话或一件事引起强烈而广泛的反响。

examples.zh: 他的一条微博一石激起千层浪，引发热烈讨论。
examples.en: One of his posts set off a wave of heated discussion.

examples.zh: 新政策一出，一石激起千层浪。
examples.en: The new policy sent ripples across the whole society.

usage.en: Common in news headlines; neutral about whether the reaction is good or bad.
usage.zh: 常见于新闻标题，对反响好坏不作判断。

meaning.en: To desert one's wife and children.
meaning.zh: 抛弃妻子和孩子，不尽家庭责任。

examples.zh: 他为了前程抛妻弃子，遭到众人唾弃。
examples.en: He abandoned his wife and child for his career and was shunned.

examples.zh: 抛妻弃子的行为触犯了法律与道德。
examples.en: Deserting one's family breaks both law and morality.

natural: a young fellow with fluff on his head

meaning.en: A green young man, inexperienced and sometimes rash.
meaning.zh: 没有经验、有时冒失的年轻小伙子。

examples.zh: 别看他是毛头小子，干活可不含糊。
examples.en: Don't let the greenhorn fool you; he works well.

examples.zh: 当年我也是个毛头小子，什么都不懂。
examples.en: Back then I was a green lad who knew nothing.

usage.en: Colloquial; can be belittling or fond, depending on tone.
usage.zh: 口语，视语气可带轻视或亲切。

meaning.en: The idea that a beautiful woman is fated to die young or suffer a hard life.
meaning.zh: 老天嫉妒美丽的女子，使她早逝或命运坎坷。

examples.zh: 这位女演员英年早逝，人们感叹天妒红颜。
examples.en: The actress died young, and people sighed that Heaven envies beauty.

examples.zh: 诗中悼念爱人，慨叹天妒红颜。
examples.en: The poem mourns a beloved and laments that Heaven envies beauty.

usage.en: A traditional trope, used in condolences and fiction; modern readers often find it sentimental.
usage.zh: 传统感叹，用于悼念与文学，现代人视其为感伤的说法。

pinyin: lǐ sān céng wài sān céng
literal: inside · three · layers · outside · three · layers
natural: three layers inside and three outside

meaning.en: Crowded around in many tight rings of people or layers.
meaning.zh: 围得一圈又一圈，形容人多或包裹得严实。

examples.zh: 展台前围着里三层外三层的观众。
examples.en: Spectators stood in thick rings around the stand.

examples.zh: 他怕冷，把自己裹得里三层外三层。
examples.en: He feels the cold and wraps himself in layer upon layer.

usage.zh: 口语，可形容人群或层层包裹。

meaning.en: To invite humiliation through one's own behaviour.

examples.zh: 明知实力悬殊还去挑战，岂不是自取其辱？
examples.en: Challenging them despite the gap in strength is just asking for humiliation.

examples.zh: 你再胡搅蛮缠，只会自取其辱。
examples.en: If you keep making trouble you will only humiliate yourself.

meaning.en: Little time left to live or little time remaining.

examples.zh: 医生说他来日无多，家人轮流守护。
examples.en: The doctor said his days were numbered and the family took turns at his side.

examples.zh: 我来日无多，只想把这本书写完。
examples.en: I haven't much time left and only wish to finish this book.

usage.en: Often about old age or illness; solemn.
usage.zh: 多指年老或重病，语气沉重。

meaning.en: Great splendour and prosperity at its height.
meaning.zh: 鲜艳的花朵配上锦缎，形容极其繁盛兴旺。

examples.zh: 贾府当时烈火烹油，鲜花着锦。
examples.en: The Jia household was then at its blazing, flowery height.

examples.zh: 盛典上鲜花着锦，热闹非凡。
examples.en: The ceremony was magnificent and full of splendour.

origin.source: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十三回

story.en: In Chapter 13, Qin Keqing's ghost warns Wang Xifeng that the family's fortunes will soon be 'like oil in a blazing fire, like fresh flowers on brocade' (烈火烹油，鲜花着锦之盛).
story.zh: 《红楼梦》第十三回，秦可卿托梦说：“真是烈火烹油、鲜花着锦之盛。”

usage.en: Literary; usually paired with 烈火烹油, and often hints that the peak will not last.
usage.zh: 书面语，常与“烈火烹油”连用，往往暗示盛极而衰。

meaning.en: Traditionally, the ideal qualities of a woman: virtuous, kind and gracious.
meaning.zh: 旧时称赞女子品德高尚、善良温顺。

examples.zh: 婆婆夸她贤良淑德，持家有方。
examples.en: Her mother-in-law praised her as virtuous and a good homemaker.

examples.zh: 征婚启事里写着“贤良淑德”。
examples.en: The personal ad says 'virtuous and gentle'.

usage.en: A traditional ideal of womanhood that many now view as old-fashioned.
usage.zh: 传统的女性美德标准，现代人多觉得陈旧。

meaning.en: A woman holding power; traditionally a disparaging way to say women should not rule.
meaning.zh: 母鸡报晓，旧时指妇女掌权，含贬义。

examples.zh: 史书中批评武则天为牝鸡司晨。
examples.en: Old histories criticised Wu Zetian as a 'hen that crows at dawn'.

examples.zh: 如今再说牝鸡司晨，只会被人视为偏见。
examples.en: To say 'the hen crows at dawn' today would be seen as plain prejudice.

story.en: King Wu said before the battle of Muye: 'The hen does not crow at dawn; if the hen crows, the house will fall' (牝鸡无晨。牝鸡之晨，惟家之索), blaming King Zhou for obeying Daji.
story.zh: 《尚书·牧誓》：“古人有言曰：‘牝鸡无晨。牝鸡之晨，惟家之索。’”

usage.en: Sexist in origin; best known as a historical term. Do not use it of women today.
usage.zh: 源于旧时偏见；主要见于历史论述，现代不宜用来指女性。

natural: have the clarity of knowing oneself

meaning.en: To know one's own strengths and limits.
meaning.zh: 清楚地了解自己的长处和不足。

examples.zh: 他很有自知之明，从不接超出能力的任务。
examples.en: He knows his limits and never takes tasks beyond his ability.

examples.zh: 人贵有自知之明。
examples.en: Self-knowledge is a precious thing in a person.

usage.en: Often in 人贵有自知之明; can be a pointed hint when said to someone overconfident.
usage.zh: 常说“人贵有自知之明”，对自负的人说有暗示意味。

natural: ten thousand qing of good fields

meaning.en: Vast areas of fertile farmland; great wealth in land.
meaning.zh: 形容土地肥沃广阔，家产丰厚。

examples.zh: 这里良田万顷，是有名的粮仓。
examples.en: Here lie vast fertile fields, a well-known granary.

examples.zh: 他家良田万顷，却一直省吃俭用。
examples.en: His family owned vast farmland yet always lived frugally.

usage.en: A qing is about 6.7 hectares in the old system; the number is exaggeration.
usage.zh: “顷”是旧时面积单位，“万顷”是夸张。

examples.zh: 这片平原是天下闻名的膏腴之地。
examples.en: This plain is renowned as rich farmland.

examples.zh: 各路诸侯都想夺取这块膏腴之地。
examples.en: The warlords all wanted to seize this fertile land.

usage.en: Literary; common in history writing and fiction.
usage.zh: 书面语，多见于史书和小说。
